# اُصْطُخِدُوا (uṣṭuḵidū) /usˤ.tˤu.xi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
# اِصْطَخِدُوا (iṣṭaḵidū) /isˤ.tˤa.xi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
